verdict.rationale: Apify's docs describe a monitoring feature to 'check the performance of your Actors, validate data quality, and receive alerts' (apify-docs-7), which matches the story directly. Webhooks that fire when a run finishes or fails (apify-docs-14, apify-docs-29) and log streaming (apify-docs-19) back up the failure-alerting and observability parts. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of data-quality validation rules and performance metrics beyond a one-line summary, alert channel/configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
